title: When the Thorn Breaks
premise: Dominic Delacroix has spent ten years swallowing poison for the crown of Veyra, numbing himself to taste, to fear, to the memory of the mother who vanished through the Thornfell passes. When the border wards collapse and the stars go dark, he discovers his immunity was never training—it was inheritance, a half-blood covenant with the dying realm of Emberhold, whose last dragon-fire is guttering out. Guided by Sera, a ward-keeper who once loved him and was ordered to forget him, Dominic must carry a spark of dragon-fire across the mountains to reforge the broken covenant before both realms starve of light. He succeeds only by offering up his own memories as fuel—and in the end chooses to rebuild them, and his love, from embers rather than return to a throne that used him.
about_author: Noor Oyelaran is a former pastry chef turned novelist who writes fantasy steeped in food, borders, and the things we swallow to survive. She lives between two mountain ranges and insists every story should be seasoned generously.

chapters.title: The Taster's Tongue
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. At a state banquet he detects poison meant for the queen, saving her but exposing how much of his own life he has numbed away. Introduces his secret night walks along smuggler roads and his fragmented memories of a woman named Sera. Emotional beat: loneliness disguised as duty.

chapters.title: Night Without Stars
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. The stars vanish mid-winter; the Thornfell wards shatter with a sound like breaking glass heard for miles. Refugees flood the valley carrying stories of a realm burning behind the peaks. Dominic's old scars ache with heat instead of pain. Emotional beat: dread and strange recognition.

chapters.title: What the Ward Remembers
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. A royal ward-keeper sent to investigate the fallen border, Sera recognizes Dominic on sight though her orders erased him from her memory—yet her magic remembers what her mind cannot. Emotional beat: grief for a love she can't account for, and the first crack in her loyalty.

chapters.title: The Smuggler's Road
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Ordered by the crown to scout the pass, Dominic takes Sera along as escort. On the old smuggling trails he knows blindfolded, they find the wards weren't destroyed—they were fed upon. A dying ember-sprite names him 'covenant-son' before crumbling to ash. Emotional beat: wonder curdling into responsibility.

chapters.title: Emberhold
chapters.summary: Dual POV. Crossing into the hidden realm, they find a land lit only by the last dragon, Ashvane, coiled around a guttering hearth-flame. The Emberfolk reveal the truth: Dominic's mother was their fire-keeper, and his immunity is covenant blood. Emotional beat: belonging offered too late to feel safe.

chapters.title: The Crown's Price
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. Royal soldiers arrive under Sera's mentor, Lord Cassel, demanding the dragon-fire as a weapon for Veyra's wars. Sera must choose between the crown that raised her and the man she was made to forget. She burns her oath-scroll and defects. Emotional beat: love outweighing duty at last.

chapters.title: Ash and Interrogation
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Captured by Cassel's vanguard, Dominic is poisoned deliberately to break his resistance—but his body metabolizes it into flame, revealing publicly what he is. He escapes with help from an old smuggler friend who dies holding the pass. Emotional beat: rage transformed into resolve.

chapters.title: The Guttering
chapters.summary: Dual POV. They reach Ashvane as the last flame gutters; the dragon offers them a choice—the fire needs fuel of true memory and willing love, not blood. Sera volunteers her remaining memories of Dominic. He refuses to let her burn alone. Emotional beat: sacrifice reframed as partnership.

chapters.title: When the Thorn Breaks
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Climax: Dominic feeds the hearth-flame his own memories—his mother, his years of tasting, his name itself—while Sera and the Emberfolk hold off Cassel's final assault at the broken wards. The covenant reforges; stars reignite over Thornfell; Cassel's army flees the returning light. Emotional beat: self-annihilation as the deepest act of love.

chapters.title: A Taste of Morning
chapters.summary: Sera's POV. Months later, a nameless taster works in Emberhold's rebuilt kitchens, slowly regrowing memories from the embers Sera saved and returns to him one dish at a time. The final scene: he tastes honey and remembers her laugh. Emotional beat: quiet hope—love outlasting memory itself.
